'''Gallada''' was a noted [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] or Crimex, who worked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|315|Gallada}}</ref> A massive [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] operation was formed to ensure his capture, after it was learned that he was moving goods and information through the [[Tion Commerce Tower]].<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
